faq: Will my site go down during the move?

Only briefly, if at all. We build and test the new home in parallel, then switch at a quiet hour. Premium aims for near-zero downtime by syncing data right up to the switch, and the old system remains ready as a fallback.
Can you migrate from shared hosting?
Yes, that is one of the most common moves. We copy files, databases and settings, fix anything the new server needs, and test before switching. We need access to the old host's control panel or FTP.
Email is handled separately from the website, so it does not need to move with it. We check that your mail records stay correct during the switch, so messages keep arriving.
Do you move Shopify or Wix stores?
No. Those platforms host themselves. This service moves apps and websites you host yourself. For moving stores between ecommerce platforms, see our store migration services.

desc:
Moving your app to the cloud means shifting your code, database, files and domain from an old server or host into your own cloud account with little downtime. Ecom Swift LLC maps what you have, rebuilds it, tests it privately and switches over at a quiet hour.

## What does it mean to migrate your app to the cloud?

To migrate an app to the cloud is to move everything it needs to run, not only the code. That includes the database, uploaded files, scheduled jobs, email settings, domain records and secrets. A successful move keeps all of those working in the new place, in the same way users expect.

The code is usually the easy part. Trouble comes from the things nobody wrote down: a scheduled task set up on the old server years ago, a file path that only exists there or an email setting held by the previous host. A good migration finds these before the switch, not after.

## Why careful migration planning matters

Migrations fail at the edges. A database copied while customers are still placing orders loses those orders. A domain switched before the new site is tested sends visitors to a broken page. Email stops because a record was missed. Each problem is avoidable, but only with a plan.

Staying put has its own cost. Old servers can run unsupported software, lack proper backups and depend on one person who understands them. Moving to an account you own, with modern monitoring and security, reduces that risk and makes future changes easier.

## How a good migration helps your business

A planned move keeps customers undisturbed. Visitors reach the same address, log in with the same details and see the same content. Behind the scenes you gain a set-up that can grow, back itself up and alert you when something is wrong.

It also gives you a comparison. In the larger package we measure how the new set-up performs against the old, so you see what changed. Performance gains depend on the old system, the new plan and your app, so we report measurements and do not promise a particular result.

## What a safe migration includes

- An inventory of the app: code, database, files, domains, jobs and third-party services.
- A new environment built in your cloud account, sized for your needs.
- A full copy of the database, checked against the original for completeness.
- Uploaded files and media moved and verified.
- Scheduled jobs and email settings recreated.
- A private test address, so the new system is checked before anyone is sent there.
- A rehearsal migration for larger apps, to find problems early.
- A final data sync and a domain switch at a quiet hour.
- Redirects and a DNS plan so old links keep working.
- The old system kept online as a fallback until you confirm all is well.

## How we carry it out

We start with a conversation and a review of the old system. We write a short plan listing each part, the order of the move and the time of the cut-over. We then build the new environment and copy the data across, leaving the old site live.

After testing the new site on a private address, we run a last sync of changed data and switch the domain. For larger packages we lower DNS caching ahead of time and use a staged cut-over to reduce downtime to a minimum. We keep the old system running until you are satisfied, and we can help shut it down afterwards. Basic covers one app. Standard handles several services with a rehearsal and fallback. Premium covers a larger system, adds monitoring, backups and hardening on the first day and finishes with a handover call.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Back up everything before the move begins.
- Test the new site on a private address first.
- Choose a quiet hour for the final switch.
- Keep the old system available until the move is confirmed.
- Tell your team and customers if a short pause is expected.

**Avoid:**
- Switching the domain before testing the new site.
- Forgetting scheduled jobs and email settings.
- Letting orders arrive on the old system after the final copy.
- Cancelling the old host the same day.
- Moving without a way to go back.

## Who this is for

This service suits a business outgrowing shared hosting. It suits a company whose developer built the app on a single old server and has left. It also suits a team changing cloud providers who want a planned, tested move.

## What we need from you

Share details of where your app lives now, what it is built with and who holds the domain. Give us access to the old host and the new cloud account so we can compare them. We never need your passwords. Access is given as a collaborator, team or developer user, or through keys you can remove at the end.
